IELTS|Beginner.meaning: but, used to show a contrast
IELTS|Beginner.translation: This bag is pretty. But it's too expensive.

IELTS|Beginner.example: 저는 운동을 자주 해요. 예를 들어 수영이나 등산을 해요.
IELTS|Beginner.translation: I exercise often. For example, I swim or go hiking.
I study Korean every morning.
There are really a lot of people in the park on weekends.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 지난 5년 동안 관광객 증가가 아주 빨랐습니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: an increase in number or amount
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Over the past five years the increase in tourists has been very fast.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 출생률 감소는 여러 나라의 공통된 고민입니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The decline in the birth rate is a shared worry in many countries.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 두 도시의 물가를 비교해 보면 차이가 큽니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: If you compare the cost of living in the two cities, the difference is big.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 이 표는 지난 십 년간의 변화를 잘 보여 줍니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: This table clearly shows the changes over the past ten years.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 남녀의 응답에는 큰 차이가 없었습니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: There was no big difference between the answers from men and women.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 전체 학생 중에서 유학생 비율이 계속 높아지고 있습니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The proportion of international students among all students keeps rising.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 우리 반의 평균 점수는 팔십 점이었습니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Our class's average score was eighty points.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 설문 결과 대부분의 직원이 재택근무를 원했습니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The survey found that most employees wanted to work from home.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 전문가들은 사고의 원인을 아직 찾지 못했습니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Experts still haven't found the cause of the accident.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 스마트폰은 아이들의 수면에 큰 영향을 줍니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: an effect or influence on something
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Smartphones have a big effect on children's sleep.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 이 문제에 대한 제 의견은 조금 다릅니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: My view on this issue is a little different.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 그 주장은 근거가 부족해 보입니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: evidence or grounds for a claim
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: That claim seems to lack solid evidence.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 저는 학교에서 휴대폰을 금지하는 것에 찬성합니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: agreement or support for an idea
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: I support banning mobile phones in schools.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 주민들은 새 공장 건설에 반대했습니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The residents opposed building the new factory.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 온라인 수업의 가장 큰 장점은 편리함입니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The biggest advantage of online classes is convenience.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 이 방법에도 분명한 단점이 있습니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: This method has clear drawbacks too.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 환경을 지키려면 작은 습관부터 바꿔야 합니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: To protect the environment, we have to start by changing small habits.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 정부는 어제 새로운 교육 정책을 발표했습니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The government announced a new education policy yesterday.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 경제가 좋아지면서 소비도 함께 늘었습니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: As the economy improved, spending rose as well.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: 이번 조사에는 천 명이 넘게 참여했습니다.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: More than a thousand people took part in this survey.

Travel|Advanced.example: 성수기에는 항공료가 두 배까지 오릅니다.
Travel|Advanced.translation: Airfares can double during peak season.

Travel|Advanced.example: 비수기에 가면 숙박비를 크게 아낄 수 있어요.
Travel|Advanced.translation: If you go in the off-season, you can save a lot on lodging.

Travel|Advanced.example: 그 나라는 삼십 일까지 무비자로 머물 수 있어요.
Travel|Advanced.translation: You can stay in that country visa-free for up to thirty days.

Travel|Advanced.example: 체류 기간을 넘기면 벌금을 내야 합니다.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: staying in a place for a period
Travel|Advanced.translation: If you overstay, you have to pay a fine.

Travel|Advanced.example: 도쿄를 경유해서 가는 표가 더 저렴했어요.
Travel|Advanced.translation: The ticket going via Tokyo was cheaper.

Travel|Advanced.example: 시간을 아끼려고 직항을 선택했습니다.
Travel|Advanced.translation: I chose a direct flight to save time.

Travel|Advanced.example: 태풍 때문에 오전 항공편이 모두 결항됐어요.
Travel|Advanced.translation: All morning flights were cancelled because of the typhoon.

Travel|Advanced.example: 기차가 한 시간이나 연착되는 바람에 약속에 늦었어요.
Travel|Advanced.translation: I was late for my appointment because the train was delayed a whole hour.

Travel|Advanced.example: 탑승 전에 면세점에서 선물을 샀어요.
Travel|Advanced.translation: I bought gifts at the duty-free shop before boarding.

Travel|Advanced.example: 현지 사람들이 자주 가는 식당을 찾아다녔어요.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: the local area you are visiting
Travel|Advanced.translation: I went looking for restaurants that locals frequent.

Travel|Advanced.example: 이 도시의 명소는 대부분 걸어서 갈 수 있어요.
Travel|Advanced.translation: Most of this city's landmarks are within walking distance.

Travel|Advanced.example: 출장 전에 회의 장소를 답사하고 왔습니다.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a field visit to look a place over
Travel|Advanced.translation: I went and scouted the meeting venue before the business trip.

Travel|Advanced.example: 한 달간의 여정을 사진으로 정리했어요.
Travel|Advanced.translation: I put the month-long journey together in photos.

Travel|Advanced.example: 대학 시절에 유럽으로 배낭여행을 떠났어요.
Travel|Advanced.translation: In my university days I set off backpacking around Europe.

Travel|Advanced.example: 시차 때문에 사흘 동안 새벽에 깼어요.
Travel|Advanced.translation: Because of the time difference I woke up at dawn for three days.

Travel|Advanced.example: 인솔자가 일정을 하나하나 챙겨 줬어요.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a tour leader who accompanies a group
Travel|Advanced.translation: The tour leader looked after every part of the schedule.

Travel|Advanced.example: 숙박비가 예산의 절반을 차지했어요.
Travel|Advanced.translation: Lodging costs took up half of the budget.

Travel|Advanced.example: 두 도시 사이의 왕래가 예전보다 훨씬 편해졌어요.
Travel|Advanced.translation: Travel between the two cities has become far easier than before.

Travel|Advanced.example: 과일은 검역에서 걸릴 수 있으니 가져오지 마세요.
Travel|Advanced.translation: Don't bring fruit, since it can get held up at quarantine.

Travel|Advanced.example: 집에 와서 하루 종일 자면서 여독을 풀었어요.
Travel|Advanced.translation: I came home and slept all day to shake off the fatigue from the trip.

Travel|Beginner.translation: I'm going on a trip to Busan this weekend.
It takes thirty minutes to the airport by taxi.
The plane leaves at seven in the morning.
Two train tickets, please.
I take the subway to City Hall.
Does this bus go to Namdaemun?
I took a taxi because I had a lot of luggage.
The train is arriving at platform three.
The hotel is very close to the station.
I'd like to book one room.
My bag hasn't come out yet.
Please show your passport here.
I'd like to exchange some money.
Could I take a look at a map?
Get off at the next station.
Sorry, I've lost my way.
Turn right at that traffic light.
The bank is on the left.
Where is the restroom?
Could you take a photo for me here?

Travel|Intermediate.translation: I booked the hotel online in advance.

Travel|Intermediate.example: 출국 두 시간 전에 공항에 도착해야 해요.
Travel|Intermediate.translation: You have to arrive at the airport two hours before departure.
The immigration line was really long.
I saved my boarding pass on my phone.
My baggage is slightly over the weight limit.

Travel|Intermediate.example: 인천에서 두 시간 동안 환승을 기다렸어요.
Travel|Intermediate.translation: I waited two hours for my connection in Incheon.
A round-trip ticket is much cheaper than a one-way one.
One one-way ticket to Busan, please.
This time I got accommodation near downtown.
Check-in is available from three in the afternoon.
Gyeongju is a famous tourist spot, so it's crowded.
We changed today's itinerary because it rained.
It's better to exchange money downtown than at the airport.
Taxi fares are higher late at night.
This line goes straight to Gangnam.
The departure time was pushed back thirty minutes.
Please text me your arrival time.
I got a subway map at the information desk.
I reported my wallet at the lost and found.

Travel|Intermediate.example: 떠나기 전에 여행자 보험을 꼭 드세요.
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Be sure to get travel insurance before you leave.
